mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the General Secretary, next to the General Secretary are departmental secretaries, each of whom heads an auxiliary committee with technical functions."
Reporting to him are the General Secretary, next to the General Secretary are departmental secretaries, each of whom heads an auxiliary committee with technical functions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right of members in determining how their cooperative is going to be managed."
Co-operative autonomy is the right of members in determining how their cooperative is going to be managed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of business organization which is formed by a group of persons."
A co-operative is a form of business organization which is formed by a group of persons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the supreme and ultimate authority, competent to decide all important matters concerning the co-operative society."
The members themselves are the supreme and ultimate authority, competent to decide all important matters concerning the co-operative society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of face to face form of communication."
Personal contact is a form of face to face form of communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that no person should be forced to join or to withdraw from a society."
The principle means that no person should be forced to join or to withdraw from a society.
fib: ______ is a global organisation responsible for co-operative matters.
The ICA is a global organisation responsible for co-operative matters.
______ is a contribution that is made to enable the co- operative society to get the needed facilities for the production of goods and services.
Capital is a contribution that is made to enable the co- operative society to get the needed facilities for the production of goods and services.
______ is one of the conditions that necessitates co-operatives coming together to form secondary association or apex organization.
Viability is one of the conditions that necessitates co-operatives coming together to form secondary association or apex organization.
______ are called affiliate-members of the secondary society which they have created.
The primary societies are called affiliate-members of the secondary society which they have created.
______ are the set of principles approved by the global body in 1995.
The current principles are the set of principles approved by the global body in 1995.
